rationale: The agent performed order-changing writes (cancelling two pending orders and initiating returns on delivered items) without any visible customer confirmation beforehand, which violates the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. Authentication is also unclear/insufficient—only an email lookup is shown, with no explicit verification step. Additionally, the user mentioned two emails (potentially two accounts), but the agent only acted on one without clarifying scope for “all possible orders.” The agent also selected a gift card refund method without documented customer confirmation. The final message is a generic closure with no clear summary of actions or outcomes. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the policy’s pass bar.
